 The Adelaide Strikers have named a 13-player squad for Saturday afternoon's WBBL clash with the Melbourne Renegades at Junction Oval.
Dynamic batter Emma de Broughe returns to the squad, with young seamer Maggie Clark returning to Adelaide to play Premier Cricket.
The Strikers will be looking to bounce back after a hard-fought contest against the Brisbane Heat at Drummoyne Oval in Sydney, where they narrowly fell short in their run chase.
South African opener Laura Wolvaardt continued her strong start to the season, producing a superb 75 from just 48 deliveries, while Maddie Penna delivered a powerful innings of 68 off 45 balls, including four sixes.
English international Sophie Ecclestone was the standout performer with the ball, claiming 1/18 from her four overs.
 Squad Changes 
In: Emma de Broughe
Out: Maggie Clark (omitted)
